name: Huick Inside Card News
summary: Turn an issue of Hankook Ilbo's Huick Inside newsletter into an editable 3:4 card news Draft in Huick's three-perspectives format, then export each card as an image.

compatibility.selects: Requires Panel SDK runScript/runShell/askAI, Draft setFrameSize, setClipTransform and addMotionGraphic, Project createFolder and moveToFolder, and the panel runtime services FileSystem, MediaGeneration and RemotionOverlay.
